purpose: Teach: 最古/三振/高地/産学/海賊版/長け/ショールーム/師団

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、学界最古の論文も読み込め
lines.en: Ren, read the oldest papers in the field too — really work through them.
lines.style: Quiet mentor authority; unhurried, the instruction weighted like advice worth writing down.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。仮説の三振、つまり三回の反証実験を計画します
lines.en: Yes, sir. I'll plan for the hypothesis to strike out — three falsification experiments, that is.
lines.style: Eager, slightly rushed acceptance; over-precise on the clarification, earnestness outrunning his breath.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、高地調査の論文を読め
lines.en: Ren, read the papers on the highland surveys.
lines.style: Short, level directive; no ornament, a beat of expectation left hanging after the period.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。産学、つまり産学連携の研究費に応募します
lines.en: Yes, sir. I'll apply for the industry-academia partnership research grant.
lines.style: Prompt and bright; careful articulation of the formal term, a small proud finish.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、海賊版論文に注意しろ
lines.en: Ren, watch out for pirated papers.
lines.style: Dry warning tone; slowing on the caution, letting the seriousness register.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。統計に長けた先輩からご指導を仰ぎます
lines.en: Yes, sir. I'll ask a senior who's skilled in statistics to guide me.
lines.style: Deferential and sincere; softening respectfully on asking for guidance, humble closing fall.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、新装置のショールームを学会で公開しろ
lines.en: Ren, present the new apparatus in a showroom at the conference.
lines.style: Firm, forward-looking order; measured pace lifting slightly with expectation at the end.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。学際師団、つまり師団的チームで研究します
lines.en: Yes, sir. I'll run the research with an interdisciplinary division — a division-sized team, so to speak.
lines.style: Earnest closing pledge; racing a little, the scholarly metaphor delivered with shy pride.
